originality.rationale: Nearest priors (Baker-Len-Morrison-Pflueger-Ren 1404.7568: 7-or-infinite dichotomy, 7422 triangulations/1278 S3-classes, honeycomb/Mickey Mouse/bridge skeletal types; Cueto-Markwig 2004.10891: 41 types with 0-or-4 lifts; Geiger-Panizzut 2112.04433/2112.04447 and Geiger 2503.22390 with polymake TropicalQuarticCurves+polyDB) contain no identical table: no published source records this exact random T0 height vector and its 12 flip-neighbour core edge-connectivity split (10x ec3 / 2x ec2). In that narrow sense the table is new and not implied verbatim by the global dichotomy or 41-type classification. Credit is limited because K4 (honeycomb-type) existence, flip enumeration, and dual-graph edge-connectivity are standard mechanical derivations from known enumerations, but no prior result publishes this instance, so originality narrowly passes.

value.rationale: Fails independently-worth-finding-later standard despite being correct and narrowly new. The admitted problem required: full S3-orbit window W at flip-distance<=2 from the honeycomb triangulation with per-orbit 7-vs-infinite verdicts, Cueto-Markwig 41-type labels, per-class 0-or-4 real-lift vectors, plus a proved honeycomb-boundary flip-to-infinite lemma (fallback: complete certified atlas with replay logs). The draft delivers none of these: distance-1 only, no distance-2 census, no lemma, no shape labels, no lifts, no bridge/infinite witness (explicit limitation 4: no ec=1 at distance 1). What remains is edge-connectivity of 12 dual graphs around one random K4-core representative whose identity as THE honeycomb triangulation is explicitly disclaimed (limitation 3: honeycomb-type representative, uniqueness not proved; 12 classes are geometric flips with distinct canons, not a certified secondary-fan S3 quotient). A 2-edge-cut is a flexibility indicator, not the infinite-bitangent criterion (which needs a bridge/contracted loop), and the draft correctly refuses to invoke the BLMR black box — leaving an unexplained enumeration of 4V/6E core graphs with a 10/2 split and no reusable bitangent certificate. This is a tiny unmotivated fragment / textbook flip-plus-connectivity computation, not a citable genus-3 benchmark or reusable flip-to-bitangent pipeline, and adds nothing beyond polyDB/secondary-fan data for downstream real-enumerative work.
